mapper.sql: user_id, desired_retention, daily_new_limit, daily_learning_limit, daily_review_limit, maximum_interval_days, enable_fuzzing, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO user_review_preference ( user_id, desired_retention, daily_new_limit, daily_learning_limit, daily_review_limit, maximum_interval_days, enable_fuzzing, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{desiredRetention}, #{dailyNewLimit}, #{dailyLearningLimit}, #{dailyReviewLimit}, #{maximumIntervalDays}, #{enableFuzzing}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET desired_retention = EXCLUDED.desired_retention, daily_new_limit = EXCLUDED.daily_new_limit, daily_learning_limit = EXCLUDED.daily_learning_limit, daily_review_limit = EXCLUDED.daily_review_limit, maximum_interval_days = EXCLUDED.maximum_interval_days, enable_fuzzing = EXCLUDED.enable_fuzzing, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING
